studies.Population: Hospital-based patients with incident histologically confirmed RCC and controls admitted for acute, nonneoplastic conditions
studies.Ethnicity Basis: NA: no field-specific ethnicity evidence was available
studies.Reference: Macronutrients, fatty acids, cholesterol and renal cell cancer risk.
studies.Authors: Bidoli E, Talamini R, Zucchetto A, Polesel J, Bosetti C, Negri E, Maruzzi D, Montella M, Franceschi S, La Vecchia C
studies.comparison_type: highest versus lowest quintile of intake
studies.exposure_measurement_supporting_text: Information on dietary habits and nutrient intake was elicited using a validated food frequency questionnaire including 78 food groups and recipes

sample_size.excerpt: Cases were 767 patients with incident, histologically confirmed RCC, admitted to major teaching and general hospitals of the study areas. Controls were 1,534 subjects admitted for acute, nonneoplastic conditions to the same hospitals.
sample_size.location: abstract; total_n derived from reported group counts 767 + 1534 = 2301

cases.excerpt: Cases were 767 patients with incident, histologically confirmed RCC, admitted to major teaching and general hospitals of the study areas.

effect_size.excerpt: A direct association with RCC was found for starch intake (OR = 1.9 for highest versus lowest quintile of intake; 95% CI: 1.4-2.6, p-value for trend = 0.001), while an inverse association was found for fats from vegetable sources (OR = 0.6; 95% CI: 0.5-0.8; p-value for trend = 0.002), unsaturated fatty acids (OR = 0.5; 95% CI: 0.4-0.7; p-value for trend = 0.0002), and polyunsaturated fatty acids (OR = 0.5; 95% CI: 0.4-0.7; p-value for trend = 0.001).

confidence_interval.excerpt: Among polyunsaturated fatty acids, linoleic acid (OR = 0.5; 95% CI: 0.4-0.7; p-value for trend = 0.0001) and linolenic acid (OR = 0.7; 95% CI: 0.5-1.0; p-value for trend = 0.01) were inversely related to RCC.

comparison.excerpt: OR = 1.9 for highest versus lowest quintile of intake

design.excerpt: data from a case-control study conducted in 4 Italian areas between 1992 and 2004

timing.excerpt: conducted in 4 Italian areas between 1992 and 2004
